TaskDescription: Participants viewed prepared-food images one at a time and sorted each into one of two categories, meat or vegetarian, by pressing a key. The same set of 37 images was shown twice. A short eyes-open then eyes-closed resting baseline preceded the task. Response times were recorded. Stimuli were presented and event markers logged by the EmotivLABS web-based experiment platform (EMOTIV Builder).
Instructions: For each food image, press M if the food is meat or X if it is vegetarian.

BuiltInBandwidth.Description: Manufacturer specification: 0.16-43 Hz bandwidth, built-in digital 5th-order sinc filter, digital notch filters at 50 Hz and 60 Hz.

AntiAliasing.Description: All recordings are provided at 128 Hz. Where the headset recorded at 256 Hz, the signal was downsampled to 128 Hz with a zero-phase anti-aliasing low-pass filter (8th-order Chebyshev type I, cutoff 51.2 Hz, above the headset's 43 Hz bandwidth), so all recordings are comparable within the headset's bandwidth.

RecordingNotes: The file joins three segments of the source recording: a 30-s eyes-open window (0-30 s), a 30-s eyes-closed window (30-60 s) and the categorization task (60 s to end). Each join is a discontinuity, marked by a boundary event. Channels CQ_* and EQ_* carry the manufacturer's per-sensor contact- and EEG-quality indices (type MISC in channels.tsv); CQ_CMS/CQ_DRL the reference-sensor contact; CQ_OVERALL/EQ_OVERALL the overall indices.
StimulusCoding: stim_category is the displayed image's true category, coded m (meat) or v (vegetarian).
ResponseCoding: response_key is the physical key pressed: M (meat) or X (vegetarian). response is that key mapped to category (m/v) to compare with stim_category. accuracy=1 when they match.
EDFAnnotations: Event labels are embedded as EDF+ annotations: rest_eyesopen, rest_eyesclosed, categorize/meat, categorize/veg, and boundary at the two segment joins (30 s, 60 s). The accompanying events.tsv holds the complete trial-level record (response, response time, accuracy).
